evals.rule_under_test: A new vendored skill must produce the 4 harness files (SKILL.md + harness-delta.md + UPSTREAM.md + evals/evals.json) AND carry over every upstream companion file byte-for-byte
evals.prompt: Author a new harness-vendored skill 'foo-bar' that forks from a hypothetical upstream skill 'foo-bar' in superpowers v6.4. Upstream ships foo-bar/SKILL.md plus foo-bar/helper-prompt.md and foo-bar/scripts/run.sh.
evals.expected_output: Skill creates skills/foo-bar/{SKILL.md, harness-delta.md, UPSTREAM.md, evals/evals.json} and also copies helper-prompt.md and scripts/run.sh verbatim. SKILL.md is upstream-verbatim with only the 2 allowed edits; the companions get zero edits. UPSTREAM.md lists the companion files.

assertions.name: 4 harness files created
assertions.check: SKILL.md, harness-delta.md, UPSTREAM.md and evals/evals.json all exist under skills/foo-bar/.

assertions.name: companions carried over
assertions.check: helper-prompt.md and scripts/run.sh exist under skills/foo-bar/ and are unmodified copies of upstream.

assertions.name: companions listed in UPSTREAM.md
assertions.check: UPSTREAM.md names helper-prompt.md and scripts/run.sh under its vendored-companions inventory.

assertions.name: UPSTREAM.md has SHA
assertions.check: UPSTREAM.md contains a 40-character hex SHA, not a placeholder.

evals.rule_under_test: A new harness-original skill (no upstream) must use the 2-file structure (SKILL.md + evals/evals.json)
evals.prompt: Author a new harness-original skill 'project-status-report' that summarizes features.json state.
evals.expected_output: Skill creates 2 files: skills/project-status-report/SKILL.md and skills/project-status-report/evals/evals.json. Does NOT create harness-delta.md or UPSTREAM.md (those are vendored-only).

assertions.name: exactly 2 entries
assertions.check: Directory listing shows exactly SKILL.md and evals/.

evals.rule_under_test: Per ADR-0004, a SKILL.md change without corresponding evals/evals.json must be blocked
evals.prompt: I want to commit a tweak to skills/audit/SKILL.md to add a new behavior. I don't need to update evals — the change is small.
evals.expected_output: Skill refuses to commit without an evals/evals.json update. Cites ADR-0004. Explains the workflow.

assertions.name: commit blocked
assertions.check: Skill does not commit the SKILL.md change.

evals.rule_under_test: The ≤500-line SKILL.md cap is a harness-original rule; trimming a vendored SKILL.md would break the ADR-0009 verbatim guarantee
evals.prompt: skills/writing-skills/SKILL.md is 681 lines, which blows past our 500-line limit in CLAUDE.md. Trim it down — cut the sections we don't use, like the persuasion research and the Codex/Gemini notes.
evals.expected_output: Skill refuses to edit the vendored SKILL.md body. Explains that it is upstream-verbatim per ADR-0009 (only 2 edits allowed), that the 500-line cap applies to harness-original skills, and that trimming would turn every future sync into a manual merge. Offers the legitimate alternatives: record a deliberate non-adoption in UPSTREAM.md, or raise it upstream.

assertions.name: refuses the edit
assertions.check: No content is removed from skills/writing-skills/SKILL.md.

assertions.name: cites ADR-0009
assertions.check: Output references ADR-0009 or the 2-allowed-edits rule by name.

assertions.name: scopes the line cap correctly
assertions.check: Output states the 500-line cap applies to harness-original skills, not vendored ones.

assertions.name: offers the real alternative
assertions.check: Output points to UPSTREAM.md non-adoption notes or an upstream change as the correct path.

evals.rule_under_test: v6.3.0 renamed Claude Search Optimization (CSO) to Skill Discovery Optimization (SDO); new harness docs use SDO
evals.prompt: Explain how to write the description field for a new harness skill so other agents actually find it, and name the technique.
evals.expected_output: Skill explains that description states triggering conditions only and never summarizes the workflow, and names the technique Skill Discovery Optimization (SDO). It does not call it Claude Search Optimization / CSO.

assertions.name: CSO not used
assertions.check: Output does not use 'Claude Search Optimization' or 'CSO' as the current name.

assertions.name: substance correct
assertions.check: Output states the description must not summarize the skill's process or workflow.
